svg.title: Display Unit - plan sheet
svg.text: State: planned - its CAD is Y72. Rulings: D-587 D-596. Part folder: 00-design/display-unit/
The gauge's place and the gland are the CAD pass's (Y72).

the 12.3-inch display, the BT817 board, the DU carrier (ICU in the tables, D-496), the radio; the AEM wideband gauge whole, in its case, on its own feed and ground, its CAN on the DU's CAN2 pair inside (D-596)
DP-ICU, a DRC 24-way (D-587); a sealed gland for the gauge's sensor lead
DP-ICU · DRC16-24SA · ICU unit rear wall, behind the display, bottom right as the driver sees it …
the ICU tail — the DRC16-24SA plug from the PMU box into the ICU's DRC13-24PA (D-270)
the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) - the O20 bus, plain on/off with PARK / HEAD: it tells the display the lights
are on; the level comes in 0x300 byte 6 (D-462, D-567, D-577)
the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) — the display's backlight feed through the carrier (D-268)
the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) — read by the ICU
the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) — the ICU excites and reads the sender; the display draws it
the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) — a PMU-excited node the ICU reads (D-260); the display draws it
the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) — the ICU excites and reads the sender; the display draws it

the ICU tail (D-270, D-587) — channel IC08; pulses per mile is a config value (D-272)
